physical_config.safety_margin_source: 0.10m proposed research assumption; not a certified real-robot clearance
physical_config.primary_comparison_admission: earliest/highest score among identically feasible candidates
physical_config.layout_parameter_scope: layout_rows/cols describe the default multi layout only; run receives an explicit layout object
physical_config.waiting_scope: mean/p95/max wait: all stationary post-spawn non-motion time; per-agent entry_wait_s is separately reported
physical_config.quantization_scope: rotation and translation phases rounded separately upward; quantization overhead reported separately from waiting
physical_config.initial_heading: aligned with first route edge unless mission explicitly specifies it

fixed4_note: Projection of legacy fixed weights [1,.8,1.2,1.5]; approach_queue is omitted, so not identical to legacy seven-feature Basic. Fixed, not trained.
common_initialization: FCFS + normalized fixed4 + four seeded random unit vectors
cache_rule: Shared observations reused within a layout/seed; every initial observation counts toward each method budget. Actual unique simulations and charged evaluation counts reported separately.
